# dsh-server-monitor
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that puts a server resource and control window **inside DSH** — no s
eparate browser tab or manual tunnel.
## What it does

- Shows memory, swap, load, disk, per-container stats and QQ login status.
- Buttons: clear kernel c

ache, restart SnowLuma / AstrBot / both.
- QQ 登录 / QQ 退出 open the native QQ desktop **inside DSH** v
ia noVNC in a near-fullscreen overlay, so the QR code and chat list stay legible. Scan the QR code o

r choose Sign out in QQ; stopping a container is not account logout.
- Collapses to a small button i
n the shell, and stays collapsed until the first successful read so an unconfigured install never pa

rks an error card over the chat.
- Maintains loopback-only SSH forwards for monitor and noVNC with a

ver the chat.
- Maintains loopback-only SSH forwards for monitor and noVNC with automatic reconnect.
This is a two-part product: the panel **plus the agent it talks to**. Both ship here — `server/` is
the complete backend, so nothing private is required to get a working install.

Only `host` and `identityFile` are required. `remoteVncPort`/`vncPort` can be dropped if you do not
identityFile` are required. `remoteVncPort`/`vncPort` can be dropped if you do not want the QQ view.
## Server side: the bundled agent
`server/` is the whole backend — no other service or private repository is involved.
| File | Purpose |

| `server/monitor.py` | The agent: `GET /api/stats`, `POST /api/action`, static dashboard. |
| `serv

er/dashboard.html` | Standalone page served on `/`, handy before the plugin is installed. |
| `serve

r/qqbot-monitor.service` | systemd unit, loopback-bound. |
| `server/selftest.py` | Asserts the live
contract (see below) against a running agent. |
[代码示例省略，未执行]
It talks to SnowLuma's OneBot endpoint (`ONEBOT_URL`, default `http://127.0.0.1:3000/get_status`) to
report QQ login state, and drives these containers by name: `snowluma`, `astrbot`. Point the noVNC
forward at your SnowLuma instance for the QQ view.
Environment overrides (all optional): `MONITOR_HOST` (`127.0.0.1`), `MONITOR_PORT` (`6186`), `ONEBOT
_TOKEN_FILE`, `ONEBOT_URL`, `MONITOR_DASHBOARD`.
### `/api/stats` field contract
The plugin reads exactly these fields; anything else is ignored.
| Field | Type | Meaning |

| `ts` | int | Unix seconds of the sample. |
| `host` | string | Hostname shown in the panel footer.

|
| `uptime` | string | `uptime -p` output. |
| `load` | `[n,n,n]` | 1/5/15-minute load averages. |

| `cpu_count` | int | Core count, for load context. |
| `mem` | object | `total_mb`, `used_mb`, `av

ail_mb`, `swap_total_mb`, `swap_used_mb`. |
| `disk` | string | One `df -h /` row; the panel takes c

olumns by whitespace. |
| `containers` | array | `{name, cpu, mem, mem_pct}`, all display strings. |
| `qq` | string | `online`, `offline`, `stopped`, or `unknown`. |
`POST /api/action` accepts `purge_cache`, `restart_snow`, `restart_ast`, `restart_both` and returns
`{ok, msg}`. Anything else is a 400 — QQ login/logout are deliberately not API actions.
Most of the values are display strings on purpose: the panel is a readout, and parsing `docker stats
` output server-side keeps the client dumb. `mem` and `load` stay numeric because the panel computes
percentages and colours.
## Security

- Control requests must be same-origin; cross-site POSTs are rejected.
- On Desktop hosts the panel
also runs the official Connection fence (`ctx.connection.requestRejection`), matching first-party pl

ugins. It is probed, not injected, so the plugin still loads on hosts without that service.
- Only f

our monitor actions are allowed; QQ login/logout are not API actions.
- The agent binds loopback and

does not authenticate — the SSH tunnel is the boundary. Do not expose port 6186.
- SSH and VNC bind

locally; restrict any publicly exposed remote VNC port with your firewall.
- No host, key path, VNC
password, or token is stored in this repository. Embedded VNC assumes DSH runs on the SSH tunnel ma
ord, or token is stored in this repository. Embedded VNC assumes DSH runs on the SSH tunnel machine.
## Known limits
- The QQ view is an `iframe` pointed at the local VNC forward, because a WebSocket upgrade cannot pa

ss through the DSH host proxy. That forward must be up before you click 登录.
- The overlay shows the
whole remote desktop, so QQ keeps its own window size. A guest screen of 1366x768 or smaller (`SNOWL

UMA_SCREEN`) makes it fill the frame.
- Host-side changes take effect after DSH restarts; the deskto

p host runs without `--expose-internals`, so module HMR cannot reload this plugin in place.
- 退出 onl
y opens the QR view — you still press sign-out inside QQ. Stopping the container just takes the bot

offline; it does not end the account session.
- Container names (`snowluma`, `astrbot`) and SnowLuma
's `get_status` response are what the defaults assume; edit `ACTIONS`/`qq_status` in `server/monitor
.py` for a different stack.
